shared_protocol_wording_clarification: The original shared-lr001 protocol says test not loaded or scored. The dataset loader actually materializes memory maps and hashes all four pool arrays before training; no test predictions or scores are computed or used for checkpoint selection in either training runner. Separate audits score test after checkpoints are fixed.
interval_clarification: Per-example approximate intervals are descriptive and do not account for model-fitting or training-seed uncertainty.
